source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "online fraud" OR "internet fraud" OR "romance scam" OR "online scams" OR (phishing AND victim)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"online fraud" OR "internet fraud" OR "romance scam" OR "online scams" OR (phishing AND victim),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("internet fraud" OR "online fraud" OR "online scams" OR "romance scam" OR ("phishing" AND "victim"))
